$comment: Generated from CredentialsFile in src/login/types.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. credentials.json in reeval's config directory, each platform's reeval login sign-in.
title: CredentialsFile

CredentialsFile.description: `credentials.json` in reeval's config directory (`XDG_CONFIG_HOME/reeval`, else `~/.config/reeval`, or `%APPDATA%\reeval` on Windows), mode `0600`: each platform's sign-in, keyed by the origin of its `REEVAL_CLOUD_URL`, with no trailing `/` or path.

SignedInUser.description: The user a sign-in belongs to, as the platform named them when it was made.

signedInAt.description: When `reeval login` signed in, as an ISO timestamp.

store.description: Where the token is: `keychain`, the OS keychain (the macOS keychain, or the Secret Service through `secret-tool` on Linux) under the platform's origin, or `file`, in `token`.

token.description: The bearer token, only when `store` is `file`.
